settings.title: Your cat steps in
settings.text: Precision weight sensors register the visit — and which cat it is, by weight.

settings.title: A safe pause
settings.text: A smart timer waits in case they come back; sensors confirm the globe is empty before anything moves.

settings.title: Quiet sift & seal
settings.text: The globe rotates slowly — under 40 dB — sifting clumps into a carbon-sealed drawer below.

settings.title: You stay informed
settings.text: The app logs the cycle and pings you only when the drawer's full. Empty it weekly.

settings.heading: Engineered to be gentle — on cats and ears.
settings.text: The sift screen and slow rotation do the work a scoop normally would, without crushing clumps or kicking up dust.
Gear-damped motor keeps every cycle under 40 dB.
Fine sift screen separates clumps cleanly and levels the bed.
Carbon-sealed drawer traps odor the instant waste drops in.

settings.heading: It only ever moves when it's safe.

settings.title: Triple-sensor check
settings.text: Weight, infrared and anti-pinch sensors must all agree the chamber is clear before the drum turns.

settings.title: Instant reverse
settings.text: If a cat hops in mid-cycle, WARCAT stops and reverses within a fraction of a second.

settings.title: Quiet hours
settings.text: Schedule overnight pauses in the app so the cycle never runs while you sleep.
